mia: starting canary for notifications-service v2.7.0 in change window 14:00-15:30 UTC. enabling feature flag `notif_v2` at 2% (quarantine cohort). release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/notifications-v2 :rocket:

deploy-bot: /deploy canary notifications-service v2.7.0 by @mia. canary nodes up in us-east1. flag state: notif_v2_weight=2, cohort=quarantine
sam: ack. ramp plan: 2% (10m) -> 15% (20m) -> 50% (30m) -> 100% staggered (1h). add 15m hold at 50%. add region override ap-south max 10%.
sre-bot: monitors attached. auto-pause if p95 +35% OR 5xx +0.5% absolute OR CPU>80% on canaries. regional-pin rule: if region 5xx >0.9% pin that region.

deploy-bot: promoted to 15%. notif_v2_weight: 2 -> 15. metrics: p95 120ms, 5xx 0.04%.

sam: enabling mute for verbose logs: `ops/flags notif_debug=false` for cohort.

(12m)
sre-bot: alert: ap-south 5xx rose to 1.02% in last 3m. triggering regional pin.
deploy-bot: executing: deploy-bot pin notifications-service v2.6.4 --region ap-south --reason "auto-pin-5xx" -> SUCCESS. ap-south reverted to v2.6.4.
mia: pausing global ramp and collecting traces to /runs/6300001111/traces. keep other regions ramping to 50% after 15m hold.
sam: rollback snippet in runbook if needed:
`deploy-bot rollback notifications-service --to v2.6.4 --scope global --reason "rollback-on-regression"`

ops-bot: partner notice queued for ap-south when region pinned.

sre-bot: runbook updated, severity sev3. decision: keep ap-south pinned, continue staged rollout elsewhere; schedule postmortem for cache TTL change.
mia: thanks team  will close thread once postmortem and unpin decision complete. :white_check_mark:
